before.title: Aluminium Tape – Cold Weather
before.alt: Aluminium Tape – Cold Weather – product photo

after.title: Aluminium Tape – Cold Weather
after.caption: Vapour-tight aluminium tape with cold-weather acrylic adhesive for insulation and sealing
after.description: Suitable for sealing insulation blankets, spiral ducts and flue gas ducts. Features strong adhesion, a cold-weather acrylic adhesive and DIN 4102 B1 classification. Available pack sizes: 50 mm × 45 m (24 rolls), 50 mm × 50 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 50 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 50 m (16 rolls).

before.title: ISOHULK Aluminium Tape AW IMO
before.alt: ISOHULK Aluminium Tape AW IMO – product photo

after.title: ISOHULK Aluminium Tape AW IMO
after.caption: IMO/MED-certified premium aluminium tape with strong cold-weather adhesion
after.description: Designed for demanding marine insulation and sealing applications. Flame-retardant aluminium tape with aggressive cold-weather adhesive; TPS Pack states temperature resistance from −40°C to +140°C. Available in 50 mm × 50 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 50 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 50 m (12 rolls).

before.title: ISOHULK Aluminium Tracing Tape IMO
before.alt: ISOHULK Aluminium Tracing Tape IMO – product photo

after.title: ISOHULK Aluminium Tracing Tape IMO
after.caption: Marine-grade, glass-fibre-reinforced aluminium tracing tape with strong adhesion
after.description: Glass-fibre-reinforced aluminium tape described by TPS Pack as IMO/MED-certified for marine use. Available in 50 mm × 50 m, 75 mm × 50 m and 100 mm × 50 m formats. Confirm current pack quantities before ordering.

before.title: Aluminium Butyl Waterproof Repair Tape
before.alt: Aluminium Butyl Waterproof Repair Tape – product photo

after.title: Aluminium Butyl Waterproof Repair Tape
after.caption: Water-resistant and vapour-tight butyl repair tape for sealing joints and connections
after.description: Heavy-adhesive butyl tape for sealing seams, closures, frames, roofs and façades. Designed for waterproof repair and sealing applications. Available in 50 mm × 15 m (24 rolls), 75 mm × 15 m (16 rolls) and 100 mm × 15 m (12 rolls).

before.title: PP-Coated Aluminium Tape
before.alt: PP-Coated Aluminium Tape – product photo

after.title: PP-Coated Aluminium Tape
after.caption: PP-aluminium tape for joining laminate foil and sealing insulation materials
after.description: Premium polypropylene-aluminium tape with an aluminium coating, suitable for use in both cool and warm conditions. Intended for joining laminate foils and sealing insulation materials. Available as 50, 75 and 100 mm wide × 100 m rolls in webshop pack formats; TPS Pack also lists 50 m lengths elsewhere.

before.title: Black Aluminium Tape AW
before.alt: Black Aluminium Tape AW – product photo

after.title: Black Aluminium Tape AW
after.caption: Black cold-weather aluminium tape for a neat finish on dark insulation
after.description: Strong-adhesion black aluminium tape for sealing and finishing insulation materials. TPS Pack lists cold-weather acrylic adhesive and DIN 4102 B1 classification. Available as 50, 75 and 100 mm wide × 50 m rolls.

before.title: Length-Reinforced Filament Tape
before.alt: Length-Reinforced Filament Tape – product photo

after.title: Length-Reinforced Filament Tape
after.caption: Glass-fibre-reinforced filament tape for securing and sealing heavy packaging
after.description: Length-reinforced filament tape designed for strong packaging and bundling applications. The glass fibres increase tear resistance. Available in widths of 19, 25, 38, 50, 75 and 100 mm, each on 50 m rolls, with pack quantities listed per option.

before.title: Machine Stretch Film Power 250% – 500 mm × 2000 m × 17 µm
before.alt: Machine Stretch Film Power 250% – 500 mm × 2000 m × 17 µm – product photo

after.title: Machine Stretch Film Power 250% – 500 mm × 2000 m × 17 µm
after.alt: Machine Stretch Film Power 250% – 500 mm × 2000 m × 17 µm
after.caption: Clear machine stretch film, 17 µm thick, with 250% stretch
after.description: Machine-grade clear pallet wrapping film. Roll dimensions: 500 mm width × 2000 m length; thickness 17 µm and a stated stretch level of 250%. Packaging and order quantities vary.

before.title: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1800 m × 20 µm
before.alt: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1800 m × 20 µm – product photo

after.title: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1800 m × 20 µm
after.alt: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1800 m × 20 µm
after.caption: Clear machine stretch film, 20 µm thick, with 300% stretch
after.description: Machine stretch wrap for securing palletised goods. Roll dimensions: 500 mm × 1800 m; film thickness 20 µm and a stated stretch level of 300%. Available in different order quantities.

before.title: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm
before.alt: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm – product photo

after.title: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm
after.alt: Machine Stretch Film Power 300% – 500 mm × 1500 m × 23 µm
after.caption: Clear machine stretch film, 23 µm thick, with 300% stretch
after.description: Machine wrapping film intended to stabilise pallet loads. Roll dimensions: 500 mm × 1500 m; thickness 23 µm and a stated stretch level of 300%. Available in different order quantities.

before.title: Cardboard Edge Protectors – Pack of 50
before.alt: Cardboard Edge Protectors – Pack of 50 – product photo

after.title: Cardboard Edge Protectors – Pack of 50
after.caption: Cardboard corner protectors for pallet and package edge protection
after.description: Pack of 50 cardboard edge protectors used to protect exposed corners and reinforce palletised loads. TPS Pack also offers corner profiles in a range of widths, lengths and thicknesses; confirm the exact dimensions of this pack before ordering.

before.title: ISOHULK Aluminium FSK Tape IMO
before.alt: ISOHULK Aluminium FSK Tape IMO – product photo

after.title: ISOHULK Aluminium FSK Tape IMO
after.caption: IMO/MED-certified aluminium FSK tape for cold-weather insulation applications
after.description: Premium fibre-reinforced aluminium FSK tape with aggressive cold-weather adhesive. TPS Pack specifies IMO/MED certification and operating temperature resistance from −40°C to +120°C. Available in several dimensions and thicknesses.

before.title: High-Temperature Aluminium Tape – 300°C
before.alt: High-Temperature Aluminium Tape – 300°C – product photo

after.title: High-Temperature Aluminium Tape – 300°C
after.caption: Vapour-tight aluminium tape with heat-resistant adhesive rated up to 300°C
after.description: Designed to seal insulation blankets, spiral ducts and flue gas ducts in high-temperature settings. TPS Pack lists heat resistance up to 300°C and DIN 4102 A1 classification. Different widths and thicknesses are available.

before.title: Reinforced Aluminium Tape
before.alt: Reinforced Aluminium Tape – product photo

after.title: Reinforced Aluminium Tape
after.caption: Tear-resistant aluminium tape reinforced lengthwise and crosswise
after.description: Aluminium sealing tape for insulation blankets and ductwork. Lengthwise and crosswise reinforcement improves tear resistance, while the cold-weather acrylic adhesive supports application at lower temperatures.

before.title: Elastomeric Arma Foam Insulation Tape
before.alt: Elastomeric Arma Foam Insulation Tape – product photo

after.title: Elastomeric Arma Foam Insulation Tape
after.caption: Self-adhesive foam insulation tape for finishing insulated pipes and ducts
after.description: Self-adhesive elastomeric foam tape for use with Armaflex-type pipe and duct insulation. Designed to help reduce condensation. Specified size: 3 mm thickness × 50 mm width × 15 m length.

before.title: Glass Cloth Marine Tape GM3
before.alt: Glass Cloth Marine Tape GM3 – product photo

after.title: Glass Cloth Marine Tape GM3
after.caption: IMO-certified glass cloth tape for marine insulation work
after.description: Glass cloth tape used to seal glass-fibre insulation in marine environments. TPS Pack describes IMO certification and good performance at elevated temperatures.

before.title: Double-Sided Foam Tape
before.alt: Double-Sided Foam Tape – product photo

after.title: Double-Sided Foam Tape
after.caption: Strong, water-resistant double-sided foam tape for mounting and sealing
after.description: White foam tape with pressure-sensitive adhesive on both sides. TPS Pack states operating temperature suitability from −30°C to +80°C, strong adhesion and good water resistance. Available in multiple thicknesses.

before.title: Blue Marine Masking Tape – 14-Day UV
before.alt: Blue Marine Masking Tape – 14-Day UV – product photo

after.title: Blue Marine Masking Tape – 14-Day UV
after.caption: Flexible blue masking tape with 14-day UV resistance
after.description: Blue crepe-paper masking tape with resistance to water and solvents, intended for modern paint systems. TPS Pack specifies UV resistance for up to 14 days and temperature resistance up to 110°C.

before.title: Double-Sided Adhesive Tape
before.alt: Double-Sided Adhesive Tape – product photo

after.title: Double-Sided Adhesive Tape
after.caption: Strong tape for permanent attachment of materials such as carpets and carpet tiles
after.description: Strong tape for permanent attachment of materials such as carpets and carpet tiles.

after.title: Waterproof Duct Tape
after.caption: Water-resistant duct tape with strong adhesion; available in different colours, sizes and thicknesses
after.description: Water-resistant duct tape with strong adhesion; available in different colours, sizes and thicknesses.
